author: willai3213
title: Exhibition graphic design project collaboration
content: Looking for a graphic designer for an exhibition at Huashan, Taipei in early December. Scope includes main visual, logotype, character visuals (6 designs, not too complex), character standees, window stickers, banners, and other exhibition collateral plus print proofing. Timeline Oct–Dec 2026. Seeking hand-drawn, Japanese, warm style with exhibition/graphic experience. Comment or DM with portfolio + quote.
